summary: Twin IQ backend tested end-to-end via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Seeded test user + session directly in MongoDB per test_credentials.md. All 17 pytest tests passed (100%), covering health, auth (valid/invalid/no token), onboarding questions (14 verified), onboarding completion with real Gemini roadmap generation, dashboard (missions seeded, stats, motivational message), missions completion (XP, streak, idempotency, 404 for invalid), roadmap retrieval, daily check-in with AI insight (real Gemini), coach chat + history persistence, weekly report (7 days, totals, consistency), and logout invalidating session. Real Gemini API (gemini-3-flash-preview) calls were exercised and returned valid responses.

minor.issue: Not exercised by tests (optional endpoint); code path relies on Gemini and should work same as /onboarding/complete but not validated in this run.
GEMINI_API_KEY is committed to /app/backend/.env in the repo. Consider rotating/removing before publishing.
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks. Recommend switching to lifespan context manager.

action_items: Optional: migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown hooks to lifespan handlers.
Optional: rotate the GEMINI_API_KEY that is checked into .env before any public release.
Frontend E2E not tested per request (Google OAuth cannot be automated). Main agent should manually verify UI flows after signing in with a real Google account.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 693 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, onboarding, missions, coach, reports) as it grows.

coach_message and other write paths call db.insert_one(dict(msg)) then pop('_id'); the pop mutates in place after insert, which is fine but relying on insert side-effects for _id is fragile. Returning the doc with _id excluded via a projection re-read would be cleaner.
get_user_from_token normalizes timezone for expires_at, but user_sessions TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=0) already prunes expired docs — double protection is good, keep as is.
seed_data_creation: Seeded user_id=user_test001, email=test@twiniq.dev, session_token=test_token_abc123 in MongoDB `twin_iq` DB via autouse session fixture. All test-created data cleaned up in fixture teardown (users, sessions, missions, roadmaps, checkins, coach_messages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_twin_iq_api.py seeds and cleans its own MongoDB data. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/twin_iq_results.xml`. Tests hit real Gemini via GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env; expect 15–30s runtime. Frontend Google OAuth cannot be automated — do not attempt.
